messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2141592468 - Prefix KV cache anomaly detected: elevated read mismatch errors across several tenants. Paging oncall @jamie. Severity: SEV2. Alerts: https://internal.monitor/alerts/2141592468
jamie: on it — pulling dashboards and logs. any customer-visible reports yet?
devon: seeing inconsistent reads after the prefetch change we rolled earlier. tombstone/stale-marker reads for some prefixes. spike started ~2026-03-15T10:23:00Z. read_error_rate 0.8% -> 5.4% on prefix shard p-12.
anya: suggested mitigation: prefix-level cache bypass for suspicious prefixes to force direct KV reads + gateway-level rate-sculpting for high-cardinality tenants to reduce read pressure. recommend do bypass first for 2-3 tenants.
jamie: sounds good. devon, can you prepare the bypass toggle payload? anya, prepare sculpt rule. i'll reach out to support for customer list.
devon: can do. admin API to flip bypass (canary to 2 pods then roll):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/admin/cache/bypass" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefixes":["tenant:acme:conv","tenant:beta:ctx"], "ttl_override":0, "note":"consistency-fallback 2141592468"}'
```
doing canary now.
anya: gateway sculpt plan: reduce RPS for tenants >200 qps to 50% and set per-tenant cap 100r/s. patch to gateway control-plane: 
```
PATCH /gateway/rate-limits
{
  "match":{"tenant_regex":"^tenant:"},
  "action":{"scale_rps":0.5, "per_tenant_limit":100}
}
```
will apply to edge nodes in batches.
sarah: support note: AcmeCorp reported 502s on embed endpoint at 10:28 UTC, ticket INC-3124. account exec looped in. drafting status page blurb.
jamie: executing steps. devon flip bypass for acme and beta; anya apply sculpt. monitor latency and error rates. rollback order: if latency spikes >+150ms, rollback sculpt first.
devon: POST returned 200, canary applied to pods {r4,r5}. canary logs showing direct KV reads now. monitoring.
ops-bot: Deploybot: config change rollout started for gateway rate-limits (change-id: rl-2141592468).
anya: gateway patch live on 3 edge nodes. observability: top-tenant qps for matched patterns reduced ~60% on those nodes.
jamie: quick metrics check: read error rate dropped 5.4% -> 1.6% in ~90s. tail latency +20ms. good signal. sarah, update customer comms: note mitigation to ensure correctness.
sarah: posted draft to status.redwood.ai: "We applied temporary routing changes to ensure correct data reads for affected customers. No data loss expected. Engineers are monitoring and will provide updates."
mike: taking handoff in 30m. anything specific to watch? i'll keep an eye on cache eviction pressure and write latency.
jamie: handoff to mike in 30. acceptance criteria to hand off: error_rate <0.5% and latency delta <+100ms for 30m, otherwise revert bypass and escalate.
devon: followup plan: add tombstone validation filter in cache read path and gradually re-enable prefix cache with extra checks. will open PR and link.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE 2141592468 - Severity downgraded to SEV3. Actions tracked: prefix bypass toggled for two tenants, gateway rate-sculpt applied, customer comms drafted. Runbook: https://rwd.internal/incidents/2141592468
jamie: thanks all. leaving notes for mike: watch kv-read-errors, gateway-rate-limit metrics (rl-2141592468), and support tickets INC-3124. i'll be available if escalate needed.
mike: ack — taking over monitoring. ping me if error_rate climbs back or latency degrades. :thumbsup:
